description: Report a documentation page that is wrong or incomplete. Use it when the user reports a problem with a page on this site, or agrees to report a problem that you found. Do not use it for product bugs or support questions.

details.description: Expected versus actual behavior, missing steps, or the snippet that failed

path.description: Path or URL of the documentation page the feedback is about (e.g. /guides/auth)

summary.description: One sentence that names what is wrong with the page

targetFeature.description: The API or feature the page documents

name: submit-feedback
title: Submit feedback
